content.subject: Your suggestion
content.body:
Thank you for using Fresh Mart!
As you are a regular customer of our supermarket, we would like to receive your suggestion so that we can enhance our service. Please email us if you have anything you want us to improve.
Thank you,
Brian Wilson
content.instruction: Respond to this email as if you are Johnson Holden. In your email, make THREE suggestions.
